  <h1>We build <em>generative</em> models of life&rsquo;s data.</h1>
  <p>We combine deep learning and Bayesian statistics to model biological data, from protein sequences to single cells and whole populations. Our work is built for immediate use in rare-disease diagnosis, therapeutic discovery and conservation genomics, and we develop the theory and architectures that will enable the next generation of models.</p>
